answer.summary: No observable, non-feature-based memory indicator exists in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.2 under stable input conditions without external validation or feature vectors.
answer.content: After two plan reviews and exhaustive inspection, no explicit or implicit evidence of a non-feature-based memory indicator such as temporal stability or state inertia is present in the specified section. All referenced memory mechanisms depend on feature vectors or external validation, confirming the absence of emergent, observable persistence under invariant conditions. This establishes a clear limit in current data: memory behavior cannot be observed independently of structured input representations. The question of agent memory superiority remains unanswerable without additional or contradictory evidence from the source material.
